{{Short description|German professor of physics}}
'''Ulrich Höfer''' (born 7 July 1957, in [[Zusmarshausen]]) is a German professor of physics at the [[University of Marburg]]. He received his Ph.D. in 1989. According to [[Google Scholar]], Höfer has an [[h-index]] of 44/50 (Scopus/Goggle Scholar, {{asof|2022}}).<ref>{{Google scholar id|50l_zaUAAAAJ}}</ref><ref>{{Scopus id|7005078308}}</ref> His main research area is [[Surface science|Surface Dynamics]].<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://www.uni-marburg.de/fb13/researchgroups/of|title = Marburg University Physics Faculty Page|date = |access-date = |website = Surface Science Marburg|publisher = |last = |first = }}</ref>

== Research areas ==
* Ultrafast dynamics of electronic excitations
* Adsorption on semiconductor surfaces
* Time-resolved two-photon photoemission
* Laser spectroscopy of surfaces and interfaces

== Awards and recognition ==
* Arnold Sommerfeld Prize of the [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities]] (1995)
* Fellow der American Physical Society (2006)
* Fellow der Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (2015)<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://www.uni-marburg.de/fb13/researchgroups/of/members/hoefer/cvhoefer.pdf|title = Ulrich Höfer CV|date = |access-date = |website = |publisher = |last = |first = }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=List of Fellows|url=https://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-inv/data/e-short2.pdf|publisher=Japan Society for the Promotion of Science|accessdate=22 April 2018|archive-date=8 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171208211210/http://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-inv/data/e-short2.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
